static_assessment.decision: Acceptable boundary for this controlled prototype, provided the guarantee is explicitly split into supervised native-process duration and a consumer acceptance window starting after expected bindings are prepared. It does not prove an end-to-end20-second deadline from request dispatch.
static_assessment.mechanism: ready_receiver prepares Expected including bindings, then assigns deadline=Instant::now()+budget immediately before Receiver::new. This removes witness preparation/hashing from the consumer acceptance window rather than increasing its20/30-second numeric budget.
preserved: current request, input/source, hash and freshness mutation guards
same Receiver issuer for receipt/revalidate pair
frozen semantic fixture and expected values
static_assessment.what_is_no_longer_claimed: The positive tests no longer establish that a result must be accepted/rejected by20seconds after native dispatch, inclusive of artifact hashing, observation preparation, semantic checks and receipt construction. A future assembled request lifecycle needs its own deadline anchored to that lifecycle; this helper cannot prove it.
static_assessment.contract_alignment: No certain contradiction was found with the supplied controlled-prototype scope. The local private-batch contract draft80-90 demands rejecting cancelled/timed-out/late/foreign results and reusing #383 supervision, but states no20-second dispatch-to-admission bound. Draft/target ledgers are corroboration, not architectural authority; #365 full remote content was not independently fetched in this bounded review, so complete issue compliance is not certified.
